cancel.restockHint: On by default when the order hasn't shipped
cancel.reason: What did you agree with the buyer?
cancel.holderOnly: Only {{name}} can cancel — they hold the money

res.title: Stock from resources
res.intro: What is on the shelf of the rikma's resources. Selling a linked product takes from it, and a cancel before shipping gives it back. The shop's own stock stays its own — the two numbers live side by side.
res.none: The rikma has no one-off resources (recurring ones, like rent, are not counted on a shelf).
res.error: Something went wrong, please try again
res.pendingOpening: Waiting for approval: an opening count of {{count}}
res.perUseHint: Per use (consignment) comes in the next stage — until then usage is only recorded, and the value is credited on receipt.
res.opening: An opening count — already credited, no new value
res.openingHint: Goes on the shelf without crediting any value — for example, what was there when the resource was accepted.
res.receiveHint: The value is credited to the giver once the rikma approves — or by silence, after the giver signed.
res.qpu: How much leaves the shelf per unit sold
res.linkHint: A link like this changes no price — it only says what the product is made of.
res.noGiverHint: A receipt needs the signature of whoever gives the resource — and this resource has no giver on record.
res.receivedGiver: Received — waiting for the giver's signature
res.receivedWaiting: Received — it goes on the shelf if nobody objects by {{when}}
res.linked: The product is linked to the resource
res.linkUpdated: The quantity per unit was updated

connect.apiBody: Two ways to connect a site to the rikma — everything it sells lands here automatically.
connect.donationHint: A donation is recorded as a sale and goes into the split like any income.
connect.starterTitle: A ready shop for your site
connect.starterBody: Catalog, variant picker, cart and payment with Stripe, PayPal or by arrangement over the phone — connected to the rikma. Deploy to Vercel or Netlify in one click, and every order lands here with its shipping details.
connect.starterEnvHint: The deploy asks for two values from the rikma — both are here:
connect.starterReplaceConfirm: The current key stops working right away, and a shop already using it will need the new one. Continue?
connect.starterSaveWarning: Copy the key now — it is shown only once. If you lose it, just create a new one.
connect.starterKeyScopes: The key gets only orders:create and orders:read, and lives only on the shop’s server (an environment variable) — never in the browser.
connect.starterKeyError: Creating the key failed. Please try again.
connect.starterDeployHint: The rikma address is already filled in on the Vercel or Netlify form. Create a key in step 1 and click here right after — the key gets filled in too. All that’s left is the details of the payment provider you chose.
connect.siteTitle: Already have a site? Report sales
connect.siteBody: A snippet your existing site sends after each checkout — one sale per payment. The key made here only reports sales and does not fit the ready-made shop.
connect.otherKeys: Need a key with other permissions (tasks, catalog)? All keys and permissions —
connect.starterDeployReady: The rikma address and the key will be filled in on the Vercel or Netlify form — all that’s left is the details of the payment provider you chose.
connect.payArrangedHint: The buyer orders and leaves a name and phone number, with no payment on the site. The order waits in the "Awaiting payment" tab, you arrange the money with them, then tap "Payment received". The deploy form also asks for the shop’s WhatsApp number (972…) — for the button on the thank-you page. A shop works this way with no Stripe or PayPal at all.

sp.noProducts: This rikma has no products yet

sp.stackLabel: Of {{total}}: {{split}} split, {{voting}} in a vote, {{waiting}} waiting
sp.flowsTitle: Who transfers to whom, if you split now
sp.voteLine: A split of {{amount}} is in a vote · {{yes}} of {{total}} approved · with no reply it is approved by silence when the rikma's response time ends
sp.emptyBody: No sales yet. Report the first one — it joins the split between the partners.

ww.openNote: A sale still waiting for its holder's consent stays out of the split until it is approved.
ww.pendingTitle: A split proposal was sent and is being approved
ww.silence: If nobody responds, the proposal is approved by silence when the rikma's response time ends.
ww.ssSub: 1💗1 joins the split as a service-providing partner. This amount is deducted from the profit shared between partners (left to split: {{left}} of {{total}}). Suggested: {{proposed}} - you may give more or ask for less; approved instantly.
ww.creatorSkipped: You chose not to give - saved when the split is created.
ww.creatorGives: Your contribution ({{amount}}) will be saved when the split is created.

pay.title: Is the payment for order {{number}} with you?
pay.body: Whoever confirms here holds the money: the sales are recorded in your name. If the buyer paid another partner, ask them to confirm.
pay.amountHint: Gave a discount on the phone? Enter what actually arrived.
pay.under: Less than the catalog price ({{amount}}) — the order will be marked as sold at a discount.
pay.confirm: Yes, the money is with me
pay.failed: The payment didn't save. Try again.
pay.holderOnly: This payment is already being recorded by {{name}}

fulfil.intro: What happens once an order is paid: each step opens a task for whoever holds the mission or role, inside the work that is already theirs. Steps never touch value or shares.
fulfil.introConsent: A step that lands on someone else waits for their yes. A step you set for yourself is live at once.
fulfil.notReady: Automation is not available here yet
fulfil.notReadyBody: The shop server update has to be deployed first. Orders keep working as usual.
fulfil.emptyBody: For example: "every order with delivery opens a shipping task for the courier".
fulfil.editAsksAgain: Changing a step asks again for the consent of whoever it lands on.
fulfil.askYou: This step will open tasks for you. Nothing opens until you agree — you can also suggest a change.
fulfil.removed: Step removed; tasks it already opened stay
fulfil.error: Something went wrong, please try again

effect.none: When done: the order is unchanged

state.noTarget: Nobody it lands on right now

f.name: Step name
f.noMissions: No running mission in the rikma has a holder
f.noRoles: No running mission has a role set
f.zonesSome: Only orders shipped to the selected zones.
f.resourcesAll: None marked — any resource with a low-stock threshold.
f.noResources: The rikma has no resources with a shelf yet. Link a product to a resource on the stock screen.
f.methodsSome: Only orders that chose the marked methods.
f.pointsSome: Only orders collected at the marked points.
f.noCategories: The rikma's products have no categories yet.
f.noProducts: The rikma has no products yet.
f.afterSome: The task opens only after the marked steps are done for the same order.
f.afterNone: None marked — it opens as soon as the order is paid.
f.routingHint_single: One holder who agreed — to them; several — the task is open to the role, and whoever takes it owns it.
f.routingHint_roundRobin: Each order goes to the next holder in turn who agreed.
f.routingHint_leastOpen: Each order goes to whoever has the fewest open tasks.
f.perUnitHint: For production: a task per unit (up to 12 per line — the last one takes the rest).
f.waveHint: Orders paid by this time go out today, the rest tomorrow. On the heart they show as one card with "done for all".
f.dueHint: A reminder is sent before it is due.
f.whyPh: For example: up to 10 deliveries a day

fulfil.introClock: A step that lands on someone else waits for their answer — and silence until the rikma's response time ends is consent. An edit by someone it lands on is a counter-proposal, and the clock starts again. A step you set for yourself is live at once.
fulfil.counterHint: This step lands on you — your change is a counter-proposal: whoever proposed the step is asked to answer, and the clock starts again.
fulfil.silenceBy: If there is no answer by {{when}}, that counts as consent
fulfil.askYouClock: This step will open tasks for you. If there is no answer by {{when}}, that counts as consent. You can agree now or propose a change.
fulfil.askAuthor: Someone this step lands on changed it — a counter-proposal. You can agree to it, or propose a change of your own.
fulfil.whenStock: When a resource falls to its low-stock threshold
fulfil.whenStockOf: When the stock of {{names}} falls to its low-stock threshold

ship.intro: How products reach buyers: delivery zones with a price for each method, pickup points, and rules for special products. The rikma's site prices delivery for every cart and address from this, and 1lev1 checks it again when the order is recorded.
ship.notReady: Shipping settings are not available here yet
ship.notReadyBody: The shop's server update needs to be deployed. Until then every product keeps its own delivery options.
ship.enabledOn: On — the site offers the buyer the methods that fit their address.
ship.enabledOff: Off — the site keeps each product's own delivery options.
ship.handlingHint: Working days (Sun–Thu) between the order and the parcel leaving.
ship.fallback: For an address no zone covers, offer "we'll be in touch" instead of blocking the order
ship.zonesHint: The first zone in the list that fits the address decides. Put a narrow zone (a city) above a wide one (the whole country).
ship.zonesEmptyBody: For example: "Tel Aviv area — courier ₪30, free over ₪300" and below it "Rest of Israel — registered mail ₪45".
ship.daysHint: None selected — goes out any day.
ship.tiersHint_subtotal: The highest tier the total reaches replaces the price.
ship.tiersHint_weight: The highest tier the weight reaches replaces the price.
ship.notePh: e.g. The courier calls before arriving
ship.whoDelivers: Who sends the parcels for this zone? A rule that opens a task for the courier —
ship.pickupHint: Pickup does not depend on the address: the buyer always sees it when every product in the cart allows pickup.
ship.productsHint: A product that is not shipped (pickup only), a digital product, or a bulky one that adds to the delivery price. The extra stays even when delivery is free.
ship.preview: Check: what would a buyer see?
ship.previewOff: Pricing is off — buyers do not see this yet.
ship.previewNeedsAddress: Pick a locality to see the delivery methods.
ship.problems: Some things need finishing before saving
ship.p_zoneName: One of the zones has no name
ship.p_methodName: A method in zone "{{name}}" has no name
ship.p_pointName: A pickup point has no name
ship.p_nothingOffered: Pricing is on, but there are no zones and no pickup points
ship.error: The shipping settings could not be saved

retry.title: This order's tasks did not open
retry.body: The rikma's fulfillment rules could not open the tasks. You can try again — only what is missing will open.
retry.failed: Still did not work. Try again in a moment.

promo.notReadyBody: The server cannot read promotions yet. After the update this tab fills in.
promo.intro: A promotion lowers prices for a while. Anything inside the envelope the rikma agreed to goes out at once; anything else goes to a vote — approve, talk it over, or put up another version.
promo.emptyBody: "15% off mugs", "3 for 100", "10% off the whole store" — each one starts here.
promo.pausedUntil: Paused until {{date}}, then it runs again
promo.counterOpen: Another version of this promotion is on the table

kindHint.item: A percentage, a fixed price or an amount off each unit — on the products you pick.
kindHint.bundle: Several units for one price, mixed from any product on the promotion.
kindHint.bxgy: "1+1", "the second at 50%" — the cheaper item is the one discounted.
kindHint.store: A percentage off the whole store.
kindHint.threshold: A discount on the whole order once it passes an amount.

promo.name: Promotion name (shown to buyers)
promo.noProducts: The rikma has no products yet

ineligible.pool: composed — the savings already go to the participants
ineligible.quote: priced by quote — no price to cut
ineligible.wish: a wish deal — the price is the customer's signature

promo.startsOnHint: Empty = as soon as it is approved
promo.capHint: When this many units are sold, the promotion closes.

preview.now: Goes out at once — the rikma is notified
preview.vote: This goes to a vote of the rikma
preview.earliest: With no answer, it is approved on {{date}} at the earliest

problem.bundle: At least 2 units and a price
problem.bxgy: How many to buy, how many they get, and a percentage from 1 to 100
problem.minSubtotal: The amount the discount starts at is missing
problem.noEnd: A promotion needs an end date
problem.endPassed: The end date has already passed
problem.endBeforeStart: The end must come after the start

toast.proposedVote: The proposal is up for a vote
toast.paused: The promotion is paused for 24 hours
toast.ended: The promotion ended — back to the approved prices
toast.policySent: The envelope proposal is up for a vote

policy.none: The rikma has no envelope yet — every promotion goes to a vote.
policy.pending: An envelope proposal is waiting for a vote
policy.change: Propose a change to the envelope
policy.arranged: Discount in a conversation up to (%)
policy.kinds: Kinds of promotion inside the envelope
policy.voteNote: The envelope itself goes to a vote of the whole rikma. Silence until the response time is consent.
